observation: Fresh main bounded repositorySummary.topLevel to 80 entries but exposed no truncation marker for that field. With 81 distinct top-level roots, topLevel returned only 80 while contextRecovery.truncated remained false because all exact path hints still fit, making the summary unable to distinguish a complete 80-entry view from an incomplete 80-of-81 view.

decision_provenance.route_basis: The defect is a narrow observation-integrity contradiction on fresh main: a bounded cognition hint silently loses reality while adjacent truncation surfaces are explicitly marked. It is directly falsifiable and requires no new context-selection architecture, so the four-mode contract resolves to DEEP_DEVELOPMENT without forced rotation.

pre_fix_reproduction: A synthetic manifest with 81 distinct non-secret top-level directories returned topLevel.length=80 and contextRecovery.truncated=false, while topLevelTruncated was absent. The new regression failed with undefined != true.
change: Compute the distinct non-secret top-level set once, preserve the existing 80-entry bounded view, and expose topLevelTruncated when that view omits one or more observed top-level roots.

validation.pre_fix_reproduction: EXPECTED FAILURE reproduced: incomplete 80-of-81 topLevel view had no truncation marker

truth_boundary: This makes the 80-entry top-level summary honest about truncation. It does not expand the manifest observation budget, guarantee full repository coverage when the manifest itself is truncated, choose an optimal large-repository sampling policy, or solve arbitrary complex repository synthesis.
